mapper.select: SELECT d.cd_grp_id AS grp,d.dtl_cd AS code,d.cd_nm AS name FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g USING(cd_grp_id) WHERE d.cd_grp_id='SGA_ITEM' AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY d.sort_seq,d.dtl_cd

SELECT m.trns_cd_grp_id AS grp,m.excel_lbl_nm AS label,m.trns_cd AS code FROM cmn.excel_map m JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id=m.trns_cd_grp_id AND d.dtl_cd=m.trns_cd JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE m.trns_cd_grp_id='SGA_ITEM' AND m.use_yn='Y' AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY m.map_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_pl WHERE pl_ym BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' AND pl_src_cd='CLOSE')

SELECT pl_ym,sls_amt,aloc_cst_amt,idle_cst_amt,drct_expns_amt,sga_input_amt,indrct_lbr_cst_amt, rnd_cst_amt,prvmn_adj_amt,nop_incm_amt,nop_exp_amt,corp_tax_amt,aloc_sls_amt FROM fin.mth_pl WHERE pl_ym BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' AND pl_src_cd='IMPORT' ORDER BY pl_ym

SELECT d.pl_ym,d.dim_val,d.cst_amt FROM fin.mth_pl_dtl d JOIN fin.mth_pl p ON p.pl_ym=d.pl_ym WHERE p.pl_ym BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' AND p.pl_src_cd='IMPORT' AND d.dim_ty_cd='SGA_ITEM' ORDER BY d.pl_ym,d.dim_val
SELECT upld_stts_cd FROM sys.upld WHERE upld_id=#{id} AND form_cd='B.11'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.upld(upld_id,form_cd,scrn_id,obj_key_val,file_nm,file_path_addr, tot_row_cnt,nrml_row_cnt,err_row_cnt,wrn_row_cnt,upld_stts_cd,ovwr_yn,upld_user_id) VALUES(#{review.id},'B.11','UI-08','2025',#{review.name},#{review.path},#{result.row_count}, greatest(0,#{result.row_count}-#{result.error_count}),#{result.error_count},0,#{status},'Y',#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(upld_id) DO UPDATE SET upld_stts_cd=EXCLUDED.upld_stts_cd, tot_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.tot_row_cnt,nrml_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.nrml_row_cnt,err_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.err_row_cnt
